personality_one_liner: Professional, ultra-clear utility tool that prioritizes large touch targets, fast data entry, and distraction-free layout for agents on the move.

spacing.rule: Generous spacing. Avoid dense layouts. Buttons must be very tall (min 56pt) and easy to hit.

screens.name: Login
screens.layout: Hero image at the top with a vertical gradient scrim fading to surface. Large inputs with 'brandPrimary' focused states. Big, thumb-friendly 'Accedi' CTA button.

screens.name: Dashboard
screens.purpose: Starting point showing today's date and the massive route selector, followed by the route's client list.

states.empty: Illustration + 'Nessun giro selezionato. Inizia scegliendo il giro di oggi.'

screens.layout: Top section: Large text showing today's date, then a huge 'brandPrimary' featured card acting as the 'SELEZIONA IL GIRO DI OGGI' button. Below: SectionList for clients, divided into 'DA VISITARE' and 'GIÀ VISITATI / GESTITI'. Client cards are large (min 64pt height) with clear typography and an icon to open the bottom sheet.

screens.name: Da Verificare
screens.purpose: List of clients not assigned to any route.
screens.layout: Standard list layout with 'surfaceSecondary' cards. Includes a sticky FAB at the bottom right to 'Aggiungi Cliente'.

screens.name: Storico
screens.purpose: Simple timeline view of past interactions with a client.

states.empty: Text: 'Nessuno storico disponibile per questo cliente.'

screens.layout: Vertical timeline layout. Each event (Visit, Order, Reschedule, Collection, Note) is a card with an icon in a 'brandSecondary' tinted container, timestamp, and details.

login_hero.alt: Professional field sales map and notes

instructions_to_main_agent: Use standard React Native components prioritizing touch targets >= 44x44pt. Client list items should be even taller (e.g. 64-72pt) for comfortable one-handed use.
Ensure 'SELEZIONA IL GIRO DI OGGI' is highly prominent at the top of the Dashboard. Use a large 'brandPrimary' card.
Implement the quick actions menu using a Bottom Sheet (@gorhom/bottom-sheet). Within the sheet, lay out the big thumb-friendly actions (Visitato, Ordine, Rinvio, Incassato, Nota) prominently.
Do NOT use any blues or purples. Use the provided Emerald Green accent palette strictly as defined.
For the 'Rinvio' (Reschedule) action inside the bottom sheet, expand options inline to show chips for 3/7/15/30 days and a custom date picker trigger.
For route reordering via drag & drop, rely on 'react-native-draggable-flatlist' combined with reanimated.
Never render text directly over images without the mandatory 3-stop vertical gradient scrim to ensure WCAG readability.
